goal: Check whether any prescribed finite Taylor order can distinguish existence of the same compensated binary choice loss and quantify the worst-case recession difference.
reference: Zero intercept and slope. Exact rational source masses represent finite equal-weight samples by replication.
prediction_path: A single linear predictor evaluated in both groups at each power and scaled inversely with power. An additional fixed-predictor comparison retains the aggregate Taylor match.
checks: matched moments and all corresponding partial derivatives
full-rank Hessian and positive-definite empirical sandwich
finite attained, finite unattained, and unbounded
independent exact checks of continuous approximation interval and rational population weights
scope: Constructed finite-design result and worst-case directional support comparison. No new human data, random draws, or checks of a proportional-dimensional limit.
